messages.author: 0a5fb98fccdeb282
messages.subject: geom_segment not working
parts:
Hi all,

Trying to plot segments using facet_plot, gives me the following error (geom_point works just fine):

  Error in facet_plot(p2, "Trait", data = dd2, geom = geom_segment, aes(x = 0,  :
  object 'geom_segment' not found

Example code to replicate error:

    tr2 <- rtree(10)
    dd2 = data.frame(id=tr2$tip.label, value=abs(rnorm(10)))
    p2 <- ggtree(tr2)
   
# this works:
    facet_plot(p2, 'Trait', data = dd2, geom=geom_point, mapping=aes(x=value))
   
# this doesn't work:
    facet_plot(p2, 'Trait', data = dd2, geom=geom_segment, aes(x=0, xend=value, y=y, yend=y))

R version 3.5.2 (2018-12-20)
MacOS El Capitan v. 10.11.6

Any help fixing this would be greatly appreciated.
cheers,
-Ivalu
